notes: Structure A — 1462 park×group rows vs 152 parks; R2=0.77 is best yet; taxon_group one-hot is strong predictor
Structure B — adding region one-hot + lat/lon to monthly; R2=0.31 modest gain; geography helps in CV not val
Structure C — ΔSDI target; RMSE=0.611 but R2=0.05 (delta_SDI ≈ white noise — linear predictors explain little change)
Structure D — yearly aggregation; R2=0.62 better than monthly (0.31); annual avg removes seasonal noise, improves linear signal
Structure E — AR(1) lag; R2=0.60 vs 0.31 without lag; prior month is the strongest linear predictor of biodiversity
Structure F — 28k taxon×month×park rows; R2=0.844 is best result; taxon_group + time + ecology = strong linear signal
